content.stem: 在客户尽职调查（CDD）中，预期应使用哪些类型的外部数据源来筛查客户？（选择三项。）

options.A: 客户反馈和在线评价平台
options.B: 社交媒体资料，用于评估生活方式和消费习惯
options.C: 制裁名单，包括由美国外国资产控制办公室（OFAC）发布的名单
options.D: 被盗或伪造文件登记册（如有）
options.E: 受益所有权登记册和负面媒体来源

content.stem_en: Which types of external data sources are expected to be used for screening customers as part of customer due diligence (CDD)? (Select Three.)

options_en.A: Customer feedback and online review platforms
options_en.B: Social media sources to assess lifestyle and spending patterns
options_en.C: Sanctions lists, including those issued by the Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC)
options_en.D: Registers of stolen or forged documents (where available)
options_en.E: Beneficial ownership registers and adverse media sources
